Staffing Schedule Salesforce Access: Coverage aligns with operating hours while Salesforce redirection and artificial intelligence integration details require verification.
Financial Expense Consolidation Plans: Financial consolidation begins in November with expenses booked directly into the entity using NetSuite.

Decisions
Needs Further Discussion
- Timeline for Finote financial consolidation: The group discussed whether financial consolidation with Finote should start in November or be rushed for the first month's closing, pending Cristhian's confirmation with Victor.
Aligned
- Prioritization of SOP and AI tools: The team aligned to prioritize setting up documentation, SOPs, and AI tools for WhatsApp and the app to handle initial support for Spain.
- Absorption of Spain support volume: The team agreed that the current support team capacity can absorb the low initial trip volume in Spain without hiring a full-time dedicated person at this stage.
- Geographic location for future support: If a support hire is needed in the future for Spain, the position should be located outside of Spain in regions like Argentina or Brazil to optimize costs and time zone differences.
- Rescheduling of meeting to Wednesdays: Rafael agreed to change the recurring meeting schedule to Wednesdays in order to include the Finote team.

Next steps

Details
Spain Support Operations and Current Volume: Dan Rizzo raised the immediate priority of establishing documentation and AI tools within the app and via WhatsApp to handle incoming support. Armando Flores noted that Danny and part of Arthur currently handle inbound support. Volume is low (a couple of trips per day). Armando Flores argued the current support team could absorb this volume without a dedicated full-time employee, while Dan Rizzo expressed concern about service quality if volume spikes. Jaqueline Sanches confirmed all support roles are filled except one open position being replaced with an in-house candidate. Consensus: existing team handles inbound with current capacity, using AI tools to filter requests, monitoring volume data.

Staffing Schedule and Salesforce Access for Spain Operations: Seven-hour time difference. Staffing weighted toward US and Mexico hours, lighter coverage early mornings and late evenings. Coverage runs until 10-11 PM weekdays, 8-9 PM Saturdays. Weekend volume not anticipated; Daniel Escribano confirmed trips possible on Saturdays but not Sundays. Spain uses a unique Salesforce instance; support team needs access. Dan Rizzo to verify Salesforce URL redirection and AI integration with Thiago.

Future Support Hiring Strategy and Location: Armando Flores argued hiring outside Spain is more economical. Jaqueline Sanches suggested Argentina or Brazil. Consensus: SOPs and AI tools first, monitor volume, defer hiring until volume justifies.

Financial Consolidation and Expense Booking with Finote: Rafael moves meeting to Wednesdays to include Finote. Cristhian Herrera: Finote runs independently this month, consolidation in November pending Victor; expenses to be booked into the entity in NetSuite. Armando Flores noted Spain currently has no management allocation (confirmed with Pao). Cristhian to confirm steps (booking, consolidation, allocation) with Victor. Dan Rizzo estimated support allocation around 10% of one person plus a small share of management.
